name: Ledger Tasks (yylo)
title: Ledger Tasks (yylo)
description: Comprehensive guide for using YYLO Ledger task management — a Kanban board and task state stored as hash-chained Markdown inside the repository (no hosted tracker). Covers create/list/search/get/mark/update/archive, dependency management (deps/ready/order), history/receipts, cold archive, cross-project routing, and typed merge orchestration across agent worktrees. The underlying YYLO CLI orchestrates multiple coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Pi) over that same shared task state.
